defects.title: Carousel (all carousel views, e.g. STACKS with Carousel on): every game re-composed every frame of a glide
defects.found: atrace TS (STACKS): 35–46 ms frames, ~24 CarouselArt + ~190 recompose scopes in a step frame; QaInval CH/CH3: ~1,000 CarItem invalidations/s, all by one DerivedSnapshotState (mapping m1431: ao0) whose value stayed false; CarRun (item body re-runs) ≈ 1,000/s with no input changed
defects.root_cause: CarouselItem read turnedFar (derivedStateOf over the item's moving place) in composition; it is re-evaluated every glide frame and each evaluation re-ran the whole item although the answer stayed false (ARCADE's derivedStateOf over its glide does NOT do this — checked, CH4 — so it is specific to this derived state, not derivedStateOf in general).
defects.fix: turnedFar is a plain mutableState set from snapshotFlow only when the answer changes (initial value computed synchronously).
defects.check: lchurn STACKS: CarRun ~50/s (was ~1,000/s); layouts.sh STACKS janky 26.6% → 22.7%, p90 42 → 32 ms, p99 85 → 77 ms
defects.verified: Thor, runs SB (before) / SA (after), 14:35 build

defects.title: Dashboard, Endless on: ◀ moves the row but the selection only changes on the second press (user report after update 381)
defects.found: 2026-10-29 user report
defects.note: UPDATE 389 (owner: still wrong after 388, Endless on AND off): 388 only moved the problem. A per-frame trace on the Thor (QaGeom, card x + which card wore the frame) showed that after every press the frame rode the OLD card ~90 px left and then JUMPED ~197 px right onto the new card (hand-over half-way) before gliding back: highlight and row out of sync, the highlighted card was not the selected one. Cause: the highlight belonged to whichever card the discrete selection / a rounded slot pointed at, not to the row's position. Fix: the highlight is a crossfade by the row's actual position (EndlessRow.kt highlightStrength / FocusFollow; StyleArt focusAlpha / styleFocus alpha): the strengths of the cards always add up to 1 and their centre stays in the selection's slot; settled = the selected card alone; a row that cannot move further (no Endless, last game) is not followed. Settled slot verified Endless on and off (Dashboard x=706, Side menu x=800 after every press). Highlight389Test. Other layouts: see SUMMARY 389. UPDATE 388 (owner recording: highlight in the third slot, two games left of it, before the row caught up): 383 fixed only the scroll TARGET; the selection still changed at once while the row glided (~10 frames), so the highlight sat in slot 3 and slid back. Reproduced on the Thor in a 60 Hz screen recording (highlight x 906 -> 706). Fix: FollowFocus now returns the item that wears the highlight (shownFocusItem: the item standing in the selection slot while the row glides, hand-over half-way), also for a reversal back to the last settled selection; Dashboard and Side menu rows use it. Re-recorded frame by frame: highlight stays in slot 2 (max half a slot off at hand-over). ShownFocus388Test. UPDATE 383 (cause found by reading FollowFocus, then checked on the Thor): FollowFocus (ui/EndlessRow.kt) skipped the scroll whenever the focused card was already in view and not at an edge, so after one ▶ from the second slot two games stood left of the selection and the row moved only when the focus later reached an edge (the row moving a press after the selection). Fix: the row always keeps the selected card the same place (followTarget, one game left of it); regression test FollowFocus383Test (4 tests). Thor 3140972f: Dashboard, All, ▶ ▶ ▶ and ◀ via vqa.sh onepress, screenshots: selected card stayed in the second slot with exactly one game to its left each time. The OLD behaviour was not captured on the Thor (fix installed first); the cause is from code. Earlier note (update 382): Thor 3140972f, installed 0.6.55 build (includes 381), Dashboard layout via preview: Game Boy 140 games, PS3 3 games and a 6-game category, single presses 1.0-1.4 s apart and fast 130-150 ms sequences, both directions, first/last wrap: every press changed the focus by exactly one game in the trace (0 -> 139 and 139 -> 0 in ONE press); a 60 Hz recording of the 3-game wrap shows highlight and hero art switching within 2-3 frames. Code read: moveFocus -> setFocus(loopStep) is one step per press; styleHomeKey returns false for ◀ on game 0 when StyleNav.sideLoops (Dashboard sets it every composition). Not marked fixed. If it recurs ask for: category + game count, which game was selected, Dashboard options, whether the second screen was on. Tooling so the next run catches it: vqa.sh onepress + focuscheck.py (ignored press / latency / --edge-ok), static ONEPRESS.
